steps.content: [Scene Change - Farland Market]

Across the sprawling encampment, only a few figures are packing their belongings. Most vendors barely look up, their attention already returned to their work. A well-dressed visitor approaches one of the stalls.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: The big blow's changed course, so we're pullin' up stakes. Ain't much left on the shelf. If you see somethin' you need, best grab it now before it's all boxed up.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: There you go! In a bit of a rush, are we?

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Ah, sweets for the young lady! Takes me right back to my own girl. Here, take the lot. A little sugar helps any journey sit lighter, and it looks like you've got a serious one ahead. You and your brother mind yourselves out there in the grit, y'hear?

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Whoa now, hold on! That's far more than we could ever use. You're too generous. Please, take some back. We don't hold with that sort of thing around here. Driving prices up just makes it harder on folks elsewhere tryin' to get by.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: I've already taken more than enough. Oh, well... bless your heart, miss, you're too kind. Well... if you're sure, I won't say no! Can't believe my luck, makin' a proper sale like this on my way out the door. My girl'll be tickled pink. Thank you, truly.
Still chattering, the vendor finally accepts the money pouch from Hypatia, his face lighting up with unrestrained delight.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: We should be the ones thanking you. Truly, we are grateful for the supplies.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: If it's not too much trouble, could you help bring these to the car? My brother is rather occupied at the moment. I'm afraid he can't step away.
The vendor, helping to load the goods, lets out a cheerful chuckle when he spots Rust in the vehicle.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: So you're the brother, eh? Keep your wits about you in the deep desert. Something's stirred up the beasts lately, more'n usual. You look after your little sister, now.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Haha, of course! What sort of brother would I be if I didn't? The kind better left as worm-food in the WhiteSands, I suppose.

This "brother" has a face pale as chalk, yet he wears a brilliant, incongruous smile. His words are even more bizarrely out of place. The vendor can only stare, bewildered, before mustering an uncomfortable smile in return. Hypatia smoothly steps in, ending the conversation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Goodbye, and thank you, for everything. I wish you and your daughter all the best.
The moment the vehicle door shuts, Hypatia's smile vanishes, washed away by a tide of worry.
[Scene Change]
Wind screams, whipping sand into a biting haze as the open-top vehicle tears across the desert.
Hypatia grips the wheel, knuckles white, her foot jammed against the accelerator in a rigid lock.
Where can they go? Where should she go?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Supplies are secured. But... what's our next step?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The communicator remains silent. With no word from Margaret, the farland mission is at a standstill.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: And Mr. Rust's condition... he can't move yet. Perhaps we should seek out the "contact" he spoke of. At the very least, we can get him to safety...
Just as she sinks deeper into thought, the vehicle jolts violently. Hypatia snaps back to reality. An ash monster is already on the roof, peering down at them.
—Bwak.

The creature is knocked clean off by a single blow from their newly purchased desert specialty: an extra-long, extra-dry, super-hardened bread. The culprit of this ridiculous maneuver is none other than the legendary agent Rust, who now slumps in the passenger seat with eyes squeezed shut, his forehead slick with sweat, like a feverish patient caught in a delirious dream.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Focus. We are technically running for our lives.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mr. Rust, you've... recovered already?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hard to rest when the driver is philosophizing and misses the local wildlife moving in.
Rust props himself up halfway, movements strained. He reaches to peel the Aurum Secretum sutures from his skin, then offers them back to her.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mr. Rust... what truly caused these wounds?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I recognize traces of an Underground origin. Similar, yet not quite the same. They leave lasting damage, don't they?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Given the severity, perhaps it would be best to reach out to that "contact" you mentioned. If they are still nearby, they could escort you to a place where you can receive proper care.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: And then what? Send you off on a solo rescue mission for Margaret?
Her face turns pale as she bites her lip.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Look, it's fairly obvious these aren't your garden-variety lacerations. This is a potent, volatile... secret power. When you're a fully-fledged legendary spy someday, you can file a formal inquiry.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Right now, I need to rest and concentrate on accelerating my recovery. If you're truly in need of a conversational partner...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Look. That bird is back.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...It's back?
Through the shroud of ashen dust, a wing of white feathers emerges from the distant haze, descending like a promise of divine guidance.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: DisCity's Peace Ambassador has come to you.
[Bird Special Portrait] [Interactive Click]

This construct is different. It is formed almost entirely of concentrated special power, using Aurum Secretum only as a binding agent. This requires the host to pour a vast reserve of their own energy into it, forging what is essentially a personal "clone."

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...Hypatia... is everything going smoothly...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Can you hear me... or... have you not yet reached a secure location...
Finally, the tears she has held back for days break free, streaming hot down her cheeks.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I-I can hear you! Ms. Margaret? Are you alright? Are you safe?
A familiar, gentle voice flows from the little bird's beak. It flutters its wings, lifting in an unsteady arc, then hovers before the vehicle's windshield.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I am well. The people of the farlands are extending every courtesy... Thanks to the intelligence you provided, our dialogue is proving most pleasant...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... I'm just so relieved to know you're safe.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry... I failed the mission you entrusted to me... and I put you in great danger.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You mustn't worry. You have already performed admirably. I'm transmitting coordinates to a location where I have arranged for support and a safe house.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You may rest and recuperate there. Once you have delivered the intelligence that you found inside Furor regarding the Underground to my specialists, we will proceed with the next phase of the mission.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Understood, Ms. Margaret. I'll set out at once... and I'll get there as quickly as possible. Please stay safe!

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Do not be afraid. Whenever you have need of me, I shall be with you...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: And I trust a certain legendary agent will, of course, honor his commitment and guide you with his utmost diligence. Isn't that so, Mr. Rust?
With that, the bird attempts to land on Rust's head. He smoothly intercepts it by donning his hat, a silent smile his only reply.
[Scene Change - Farland Market]

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: ...Name's Helga, with the Farland Alliance. You can trust me. We're tracking two DisCity spies who pose a severe threat to the Alliance, and I need your eyes. Just tell me straight: have any outsiders come through here?

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: DisCity... spies? No wonder... No, ma'am, I sure haven't. Never laid eyes on a Disian in my life! DisCity's a world away. What'd they be doin' all the way out here?
Saina leans close to whisper something in Helga's ear. Then she saunters toward the vendors, her voice rising clear and deliberate as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: The two DisCity spies we're looking for are a man and a woman. They're killers. So I suggest every one of you think very carefully about whether you've seen them. Or...

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: ...would you like me to help jog your memory?
[Scene Change]
With the coordinates recalibrated, the off-road vehicle tears across the Whitesands, throwing up a plume of pale dust.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: That perked you right up, didn't it? She certainly has a way with young girls.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Because... at least now I know what to do...

Margaret is safe, the plan can proceed, their objective unchanged. It's an enormous relief for Hypatia, who had feared she'd ruined everything. To make amends, she floors the accelerator, pushing the vehicle forward in a determined surge.

Outside, the Whitesands blur past in a pale monotony, but the scholar's eye catches irregularities along their route. Each time they pass large rock formations, clusters of shadow linger in the darkened recesses.
They gather in strange silhouettes, small groups lurking near the sandy paths. Their intent, and their target, is unmistakably clear.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...What... are those?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Pursuers. Stay sharp.
Rust tightens his grip on the gun he never holstered. Before his warning can fully leave his lips, the figures vanish, only to reappear instantly, clinging to the sides of their off-road vehicle.

A dull thud of metal, an explosive bang of tires. The vehicle lurches violently, nearly throwing Rust clear. He summons every ounce of strength to wrench the wheel, aiming their ruined momentum straight for a fragile section of rock wall.
